Revision4:150 person descriptions,150 encounter moments,100 direct-address titles,74 place/time settings and26 small details. Each changed title was read against its existing story; exact supporting excerpts or venue records are recorded per note. Bodies and locations are unchanged. Style mix is editorial guidance, not fabricated detail.
